title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the State-owned Land Use Right May Be Converted into Value to Satisfy the Mortgagee

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:

We have received your Request on Whether State-owned Land Use Rights May Be Transferred to the Mortgagee at the Price Determined by the Land Administration Department (Chuan Gao Fa [1998] No. 19). Upon deliberation, we reply as follows:

In a security dispute case where the state-owned land use right is mortgaged according to law, if the mortgagee has not been satisfied upon the expiration of the debt performance period, the land use right may be realized through auction. If realization through auction is impossible and the debtor has no other property available for satisfaction, the state-owned land use right shall be appraised according to law. The People's Court may, by reference to the land price appraisal result confirmed by the government land administration department, convert the land use right into monetary value. With the consent of the mortgagee, the land use right after such conversion may be transferred to the mortgagee in satisfaction of the debt, and the mortgagee shall enjoy the land use right.

This is our reply.
